mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies and 55 degree temperatures at Reddan Soccer Park. The air quality index is currently 56, and we are seeing a third quarter moon phase this morning.

The Public Works Department reminds residents that refuse and recycling collection is managed by Pellitteri Waste Systems. You can visit the city website to find your specific collection calendar, download the app for service alerts, or use the Waste Wizard tool to determine how to properly dispose of tricky items.

We have plenty of local activities on the calendar, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow is packed with options, including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee.
Looking at the weekly report, on October 25, officers found a man passed out behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, leading to an arrest for O W I, first offence.
If you are craving something sweet, stop by Culver today for the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM.
